entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The adult man in the center foreground, with side-parted brown hair and a thin mustache, wearing a dark purple tailcoat-style long coat, white shirt, black bow tie, and light gray trousers, and holding a small notebook.

entities.name: Person B

entities.name: red patterned carpet

entities.name: large potted palm

entities.name: Person F
entities.identification: The adult attendant to the left of Person A, wearing a dark purple uniform and cylindrical hat, with the hat strap extending along the cheeks, and holding one dark object in each hand.

entities.name: Person G

entities.name: Animal A

entities.name: brown folder with an emblem

entities.name: cream-pink wall and arched niche
entities.identification: The light warm-pink walls at the rear and on the right side of the lobby, with rectangular sections and arched decorative areas.

entities.name: golden-brown stone-faced column
entities.identification: The tall golden-brown stone-faced column on the left side of the passage, with irregular surface textures and vertical divisions.

entities.name: warm-white globe lights and wall lights

entities.name: wood-framed upholstered chair in the lobby
entities.identification: The brown wood-framed upholstered chairs in the lounge area, with light beige or brown upholstery, recorded as a group of the same type.

entities.name: small round table in the lobby
entities.identification: The small table between the seats in the lounge area on the right, with part of its dark curved tabletop edge visible in the early frames.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The other people in the distant lobby and lounge area, including people who are seated, standing, or passing by.

entities.name: metallic round flowerpot

entities.name: glossy black handbag
entities.identification: The glossy black handbag in front of Person G, offset toward image-right, with a horizontally rectangular body and its upper strap partially occluded.

entities.name: staircase
entities.identification: The staircase ascending at the rear left of the lobby, with red carpet covering the steps and part of a light-colored railing structure along the side.

entities.name: light-colored ceiling
entities.identification: The flat light warm-pink ceiling surface above the lobby, with straight boundary junctions and beam-like structures along the edges.

entities.name: geometric-patterned floor
entities.identification: The floor area visible beside the red passage, with a light-colored base and dark repeating patterns.

entities.name: cups and saucers on the tabletop
entities.identification: The small light-colored cup-and-saucer-shaped objects and reflective objects on the tabletops in the lounge area.

entities.name: two dark long-handled objects
entities.identification: The two dark, narrow, elongated objects, one held in each of Person F's hands; one has a wider curved lower end, while the other is partly thinner.
